observations.behavior: Adds a check for the `ADMIN_PORTAL_ENABLED` setting before treating the request path as an admin view.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent the middleware from incorrectly applying the strict admin CSP policy to requests when the admin portal is disabled, potentially avoiding a false-positive security enforcement. However, without seeing the rest of the middleware, it is unclear if this check is sufficient or if the app's own policy is still applied.
